Package edu.ncsu.csc216.pack_scheduler.course

Class Course

java.lang.Object
edu.ncsu.csc216.pack_scheduler.course.Activity
edu.ncsu.csc216.pack_scheduler.course.Course
All Implemented Interfaces:
Conflict, Comparable<Course>
public class Course extends Activity implements Comparable<Course>
Class representing a Course at NC State with a name, title, section, credits, instructor, meeting days and meeting times. Can check for duplicate courses based on name, and implements comparable sorting by title then section number, and a course is less than another when their title or section number is less than alphabetically.
Author:
Liam Yeager

    • setMeetingDaysAndTime

      public void setMeetingDaysAndTime(String meetingDays, int startTime, int endTime)
      Sets the meeting days and start and end times. A meeting day is invalid if it consists of any characters other than ‘M’, ‘T’, ‘W’, ‘H’, ‘F’, or ‘A’, or has a duplicate character. If ‘A’ is in the meeting days list, it must be the only character. The start time is invalid if it is not between 0000 and 2359 or if it is an invalid military time. The end time is invalid if it is not between 0000 and 2359 or if it is an invalid military time. The end time is invalid if it is less than the start time (i.e., no overnight classes). The start time and/or end time is invalid if it is listed when meeting days is ‘A’
      Overrides:
      setMeetingDaysAndTime in class Activity
      Parameters:
      meetingDays - the days of the week the course meets
      startTime - the starting time of the course
      endTime - the ending time of the course
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the meeting day or time fields are invalid.

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(Course c)
      Compares this Course with another Course. Returns a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this Course is less than, equal to, or greater than the other Course. Courses are ordered by title then section number and a course is less than when their title or section number is less than alphabetically (depending on which parameters are the same).
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<Course>
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the integer representing if this Course is less than, equal to, or greater than the other Course
